context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 外注/両社/差し支え/損ね/歯科医/部内/組立/伝票

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、業務、外注を活用する判断、大事だ。
lines.en: Ren — knowing when to outsource is a crucial call to make.
lines.style: Measured opening. Calm authority without harshness. Settles on the word 'crucial' with quiet weight. This is teaching through conversation, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。両社のWin-Win関係、目指したいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to build a real win-win with the partner firm.
lines.style: Earnest and direct. Slight lean forward in the voice. No hedging — he means it. Respectful but not deferential. This is him committing to understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業務に差し支えのない範囲で、若手にチャンスを与える。
lines.en: And within reason, give the younger staff real chances to develop.
lines.style: Gentle but firm conviction. Slight pause before 'younger staff' — choosing words carefully. This is principle, not just instruction. Spoken like someone who remembers being young.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩を損ねないよう、配慮します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure not to step on anyone's toes.
lines.style: Respectful, careful. Almost too careful — the anxiety of someone aware of the hierarchy. Shorter breath at the end, like he's trying not to over-promise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若いうちに、歯科医、定期的に通え。
lines.en: By the way — go see a dentist regularly while you're young.
lines.style: Sudden shift to practical concern. Fatherly, almost, but delivered like a normal fact. Light and quick — doesn't linger on it, but doesn't apologize for saying it either.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。部内のミーティング、参加できますか。
lines.en: Yes. Can I attend the section meeting next week?
lines.style: Respectful question. Slightly anxious note underneath — he's asking permission, not stating. Quick, efficient, already moving toward the next thing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: うん。組立現場の見学、来週、連れて行く。
lines.en: Yes. I'll take you to the assembly floor next week.
lines.style: Warm shift. Ownership in the voice — he's decided this matters and he'll make it happen. Not negotiable, but offered with care. Like opening a door for him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。伝票管理の流れ、勉強します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll study the voucher-tracking system thoroughly.
lines.style: Closing note of sincere commitment. Quiet determination. The energy of someone who's understood a real responsibility has been placed in his hands. Slight uptick at 'thoroughly' — he's ready.
